purpose: Teach: つたの/見込ま/名づけ/転がっ/くっつい/とどまる/はじまる/かかえ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭につたのからまる垣根が綺麗ね
lines.en: Sho, the ivy on the garden fence is really beautiful, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft, pleased tone. Eyes following something in the distance. Not performing the moment — living it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが宿題を見込まれてると思うと頑張れるよ
lines.en: Mom, when I think Dad's going to check my homework, I can work harder.
lines.style: Quiet certainty underneath. Not boastful — just honest about what helps him. Small voice, steady. The confidence of a child who knows he's noticed something true.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがぬいぐるみに名づけて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad gave names to the stuffed animals, didn't he.
lines.style: Soft recognition of a small kindness. Slight warmth in the voice — the way a parent notices what their partner does when no one's asking them to. Tender, not sentimental.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お部屋にボールが転がってるから片付けるね
lines.en: Mom, there's a ball rolling around in my room, so I'm going to clean it up.
lines.style: Small voice with purpose. Not seeking praise — just stating what needs doing and that he'll do it. Natural, unselfconscious. The matter-of-factness of a six-year-old helping.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとくっついてお話するの好きね
lines.en: Sho, you really like staying close to your dad and talking with him, don't you.
lines.style: Tender observation, almost wondering. Not questioning — noticing aloud. Slight pause before the final words, like she's seeing something precious in him. Warm, quiet recognition.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、玄関にとどまる時は静かにするね
lines.en: Mom, when I'm at the front door, I keep quiet so I don't get in the way.
lines.style: Small, serious tone — not self-pitying, just matter-of-fact about his quiet way. Determined but not loud. The kind of careful that a sensitive child carries naturally.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとの会話がはじまるとお家が明るくなるわ
lines.en: Sho, the whole house gets brighter when you and your dad start talking.
lines.style: Reflective, almost vulnerable — she's letting him hear what she's noticed about the two of them together. Quiet, genuine. The kind of thing said not for effect but because it needed saying. Slight wonder in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが重い荷物をかかえてらしたから手伝ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw Dad carrying something really heavy, so I helped him with it.
lines.style: Quiet pride without boasting. Direct and simple — not looking for praise, just reporting what he did. Small steady voice. The ease of a child who helped because it was obvious he should.
